method: Hugging Face HTTP API metadata (dataset info with blobs, paginated recursive trees), cards, the SimReady Central GitHub index (NVIDIA-Omniverse/simready-central submissions/), a crawl of every nvidia/simready-assets payloads/Physics/physics.usda (text), and 7 sampled packages opened with pxr (USD only, textures skipped) in data/external/simready_sample/
notes: packages_on_main counts dirs holding com.nvidia.simready.packaging.json; repos without that layout have 0 and are counted from their cards
size_GB_listed sums listed file sizes on main (duplicated textures counted twice); used_storage_GB is the deduplicated LFS storage reported by the Hub
nvidia/simready-catalog does not exist on the Hub (401); the index lives at github.com/NVIDIA-Omniverse/simready-central
household categories for nvidia/simready-assets come from the name prefix (food_, kitchenware_, cleaning_, ...), approximate

repos.role: robots and grippers for Isaac Sim
NVIDIA's own SimReady library (core of SimReady Central)
repos.asset_count_basis: packages (dirs with com.nvidia.simready.packaging.json); 2,536 registered in the Central index
repos.physics: UsdPhysics RigidBodyAPI+MassAPI (mass, centerOfMass, diagonalInertia, principalAxes) and PhysicsMaterialAPI (density, static/dynamic friction, restitution) per material class; CollisionAPI on visual-resolution meshes with per-solver variants (PhysX: sdf, MuJoCo: convexHull, Newton: no approximation authored = triangle mesh) plus newton:rollingFriction/torsionalFriction/contactGap; revolute/prismatic/fixed joints with limits and drives on articulated items (drawers, doors, levers); Z-up, metersPerUnit 1, kilogramsPerUnit 1 (sampled)
repos.deformable: none authored; towels/cloths/sponges/drapes/bandages/hoses are single rigid bodies (sampled cleaning_towel_a01: rigid, 0.24 kg, density 1000)

physics_crawl.deformable_note: token search (Deformable|Cloth|Particle|SoftBody) over 2,669 physics layers matched only a prim NAME (cleaningCloth_01_obj_00); no deformable schema anywhere
physics_crawl.approximation_note: collision approximation is authored in the solver variant layers (PhysX/enabled.usda: sdf; MuJoCo/enabled.usda: convexHull), not in Physics/physics.usda; MassAPI mass mostly in base.usda (all sampled assets have mass, CoM, inertia)
